blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Meeting with the guide. Today you will have a rich excursion program! You're heading to the Brazilian side of the Foz do Iguaçu Falls, which border the Iguazu River Canyon. To say that this is a magnificent sight does not in any way express the emotions that you will be subject to. The waterfalls are located in a national park with unique flora and fauna. They arose as a result of a volcanic eruption and the displacement of the earth's strata.  The name of the waterfalls means "big water" in Guaraní. 275 waterfalls, each with its own name, merge into one, crashing into the Devil's Throat Gorge. The sight of water spray in the halo of the rainbow spectrum is simply fascinating. On the way to the most powerful waterfall called "Devil's Throat" you will see many small waterfalls. Rainbow splashes, billions of drops of falling water and magnificent landscapes cause incomparable delight.

Optionally you can order 

Visit to the Bird Park 

 It is located near the Iguaszu National Park. You will enter huge aviaries, in which amazing, fabulous birds of outlandish colors freely fly or walk among the rainforest. 

Makuko Safari Journey

You will drive through the jungle in the open body of a jeep for about 3 kilometers, accompanied by a guide who will tell you a lot of interesting things about the ecology of the region. Then you will walk to the banks of the Iguaszu River, from where you will be taken by motorboat close to the waterfalls. Splashes and rainbows, a sea of delight and unique photos await you.
